title: The last blocks of a JA Diner build and the largest JA Boxing groups are settled, and plan slips are decided by code
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: Spaced emphasis codes pass the look guard; a copy-written menu label stands; undecided links with one answer, plan shape slips and card links are settled by code; a plan path to a kept page links to the page; writer words in url, picture or empty fields are noted, not written; a stored field repeating a written heading takes its words; a brand name printed as an alt is not a template alt.

tests: a code written with spaces, stored as its tag, is still only a change of emphasis form
the planned top-level News page leaves demo menu ancestors and restores them before a rerun
a picture that opens itself is hidden, and a link to a kept page whose label is decided is kept
a page's blocks under another name are its blocks, and a shared block decided again on a page is the shared one's
a card's link that opens its own item leads to that item's kept page, and stays with the planner when it is dropped
a path the plan names that is a kept page's slug or kit path is that page, never a bare path
words the writer puts in a picture slot or a url slot are not written, and leave no dispute with its owner
words for a field the template keeps empty are not sent: the site never fills it
a stored field repeating a written heading of its module takes the heading's new words
the business's name the brand step wrote, printed as a picture's alt, is not a template alt
